text: The joint communique on Mr. Kennedy's and Mr. Macmillan's third talks - the first were at Key West, Florida, the second in Washington - said:"Their discussions covered the major problems, both economic and political, and revealed once again the close agreement of the two Governments in pursuing their common purposes.", Occasions were given to review the need for economic cooperation and expansion in the general interests of developed and underdeveloped countries alike.
